# Solver CLI — Command Reference

Reference for registered top-level `node scripts/solve.js` commands.
The coverage count checks top-level entries, not every nested operation or flag.
Ground truth is the dispatch map and handlers in
[`scripts/solve.js`](../../../scripts/solve.js); descriptions live in the

the [`owner router`](../router.md) for the authority behind each guardrail command map.

| Command | Purpose | Usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | Seal a quest: validate solve/quests/<id>/quest.json and its epic, measure the doneWhen probe, refuse unless the probe is red, then record sealedAt (HEAD) and the seal-time metric in the log. | `node scripts/solve.js start --id <quest> [--json]` |
| `note` | Append a finding, one hypothesis/change/measurement attempt, a content-bound independent verification, a package assignment/amendment with an existing authority reference, a resumable blocked hold, or terminal exhausted/superseded outcome. Assignment and untyped observations preserve holds; attempts and typed findings clear the current projection hold. | `node scripts/solve.js note --id <quest> (--finding "<text>" [--kind <kind>] [--status <status>] [--evidence <ref>] \| --attempt "<what changed>" \| --assignment "<reason>" --paths-file <list> --authority "<existing authorization>" \| --verification "<summary>" --verifier subagent:<id> --verdict approve\|reject \| --blocked "<why>" --next-owner judgment\|verification\|authorization \| --exhausted "<why>" \| --superseded "<why>" [--by <quest>]) [--json]` |
| `probe` | Measure a quest's doneWhen (or an epic's with --epic): metric, target, done, whether it measured, the delta from the seal-time value, and the last three log entries. | `node scripts/solve.js probe --id <quest> \| --epic <epic> [--json]` |
| `land` | Land a sealed Quest after its probe, current package assignment and applicable epic scope, independent content-bound review for source/proof/acceptance changes, altitude and interaction guards, static checks and staged change proof pass. Collects all changed paths; isolate unrelated work. Required generated outputs must fit the assignment. Commits and records solved; never pushes. | `node scripts/solve.js land --id <quest> [--json]` |
| `evidence` | Add uploads and verifies by re-download/hash before recording evidence; --replace requires deliberate replacement authority. Delete requires the exact --authorize-asset value. Relocate preserves source provenance, verifies custody and records into an open Quest; --dry-run previews. Evidence upload writes a typed finding that clears a current blocked hold; retain unresolved holds explicitly. | `node scripts/solve.js evidence (add <file> --id <quest> [--text "<why>"] [--replace] \| delete <asset> --authorize-asset <asset> \| relocate --id <quest> --paths-file <list> --source-commit <sha> [--record-to <quest>] [--label <name>] [--dry-run]) [--json]` |
| `board` | Print the open epics and open quests computed from solve/epics and solve/quests on demand; nothing is written. | `node scripts/solve.js board [--json]` |
